# InsightAI

End-to-End Data Science , Artificial Intelligence and GenAI project.

## Goal

Build a practical business intelligence system that can:

- Analyze business data 
- Perform exploratory data analysis
- Build machine learning models
- Use LLMs
- Implement RAG
- Build AI agents 
- Automate business analysis

## Technologies
- Python
- SQL
- NumPy
- Pandas
- Matplotlib
- Seaborn
- Machine Learning
- LLM APIs
- Langchain
- RAG
- CrewAI
- AutoGen
